name: Ikebukuro
description: Ikebukuro from open data, lit by the real sun: Sunshine 60 over the east side, Sunshine 60-dori's signs and Otome Road behind it, the department stores round the station, and West Gate Park's GLOBAL RING.

imagery.attribution: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) seamless aerial photographs (GSI terms of use, source attribution)

terrain.attribution: GSI Fundamental Geospatial Data DEM5A, 5 m airborne laser survey bare earth (GSI terms of use); 10 m DEM where 5A is absent

terrain_check.name: GSI elevation API (1 m laser DEM where flown, otherwise DEM5)

plateau.attribution: MLIT Project PLATEAU Tokyo 23 wards LOD2 building models (CC BY 4.0), as vector tiles by indigo-lab (MIT)

seawall.note: The rivers' and the bay's revetments and the castle moats: granite blocks and concrete.

trees.note: Species are not mapped, and the shared trees have no ginkgo or cherry, so the mix stands in: elms for the zelkovas (keyaki) of the avenues and parks, plane trees for the street planes and ginkgos. A guess, not a survey.

tour.title: Ikebukuro, from open data
tour.text: {buildings} buildings. {share:plateau}% of the footprint area stands at a height Project PLATEAU surveyed, on GSI's 5 m laser-scanned bare earth.

tour.title: Sunshine 60-dori
tour.text: From the east exit to Sunshine City: arcades, karaoke and ramen, and Otome Road behind. The signs here are typical of the street, not its real shops'.

tour.title: West Gate Park
tour.text: GLOBAL RING over the open-air theatre, and the Metropolitan Theatre's glass beside it.

sources.landmarks: GLOBAL RING (Toshima City, 2019), about 35 m across, its height from photographs. The roof names are the stores' own words in open fonts, not their logos; the street signs are indicative: typical trades, no real shops' signs.
sources.fonts: Signs drawn with Google Fonts under the SIL Open Font License: Zen Kaku Gothic New, Dela Gothic One, M PLUS Rounded 1c, Bebas Neue, Shippori Mincho

night.note: The street signs, the roof names and the ring's LED rings are lit landmark meshes (city.py); the streets' lamps are the country's defaults.

game.title: Ikebukuro on Foot
game.blurb: Walk Ikebukuro under the real sun: along Sunshine 60-dori to the tower, round Otome Road's shops, and through the station to West Gate Park's ring.

spots.name: Sunshine 60 サンシャイン60
lines: Sunshine 60: 240 metres, the tallest in Asia when it opened in 1978. Sixty floors, and an aquarium on the roof of the building beside it.
The prison where the war's leaders were held stood here. They built a city on it, and a park for the people who remembered.

spots.name: Otome Road 乙女ロード
lines: Otome Road: the maidens' road. Books, goods and cafes for women fans, since the 2000s.
On a release day the line for one shop goes round the block, and nobody complains.

npcs.name: Hiro 宏
idle: Ikebukuro is the ramen battlefield. Forty shops within ten minutes of the station, and every one says it's the best.
Mine's tonkotsu, twelve hours on the bone. {time}.

npcs.name: Yumi 由美
idle: Our penguins swim over your head, against the sky: a glass tank on the roof, forty metres up.
The sea lions eat at three. Come and watch. {sun_line}

npcs.name: Rin 凛
idle: Otome Road's shops sell to women fans: books, badges, acrylic stands. Akihabara has the boys; we have the girls.
The butler cafe's just round the corner. 'Welcome home, my lady.'

npcs.name: Kaito 海斗
idle: We practise under the ring at night: the glass of the theatre's a good mirror.
This park was in a TV drama in 2000. My father still calls it the West Gate Park, like the kids in it.

quests.title: Ikebukuro
talk: Welcome to Ikebukuro! The east exit has Seibu, the west exit has Tobu. Don't ask me why; nobody knows.
Walk down Sunshine 60-dori to the tower. Yumi at the aquarium knows the east side better than anyone.

quests.title: Sunshine 60
talk: Look up: Sunshine 60. From the deck you can see Fuji on a clear morning.
Behind us is Otome Road. Rin works in a bookshop there.

quests.title: Otome Road
talk: Welcome to Otome Road. Pick a shop, any shop. Second floor up is where the good stuff is.
And if you're tired: the butler cafe. They call everyone 'my lady'.

quests.title: West Gate Park
talk: West Gate Park. Through the station and out the other side: everybody gets lost the first time.
Look at the ring after dark. Five rings of light, over the theatre.
